description: Adversaries may attempt to dump credentials to obtain account login and credential material, normally in the form of a hash or a clear text password, from the operating system and software. Credentials can then be used to perform Lateral Movement and access restricted information.
artifacts: SMB connections to ADMIN$ share for registry access
RPC calls to SAMR (Security Account Manager Remote) protocol
RPC calls to LSARPC (Local Security Authority Remote) protocol
SMB file operations on registry hives
authentication attempts with elevated privileges (SYSTEM or Administrator)
failed access attempts due to insufficient privileges
SAM and LSA database extraction attempts

pcaps.name: Internal SAM and LSA registry dump - successful (secretsdump)
pcaps.description: Internal authenticated SAM and LSA registry dump using secretsdump.py (impacket) showing successful extraction of credential hashes from Security Account Manager and Local Security Authority databases via registry access.

pcaps.name: Internal SAM and LSA registry dump - failed no privileges (secretsdump)
pcaps.description: Internal authenticated SAM and LSA registry dump attempt using secretsdump.py (impacket) showing failed access due to insufficient privileges (user authenticated but lacks SYSTEM or Administrator rights).

pcaps.name: Internal SAM and LSA registry dump - failed bad password (secretsdump)
pcaps.description: Internal unauthenticated SAM and LSA registry dump attempt using secretsdump.py (impacket) showing failed authentication due to incorrect credentials.
